sources.title: LAFD battery truck incident account
sources.supported_background: Records the September 2024 battery truck incident and subsequent clearance. Does not provide this cohort or simulation timings.

sources.title: Port of LA road reopening update
sources.supported_background: Reports roads open and expected terminal recovery; expectation is not confirmation of full recovery.

sources.title: ONE customer notice
sources.supported_background: Carrier-specific fee-clock notice; not a universal waiver and not a quantified saving for this cohort.

sources.title: Maersk cyber incident update
sources.supported_background: June 2017 cyber incident affected systems and operations. Does not establish a Terminal49 outage.

sources.title: Torres official statement
sources.supported_background: Official statement discusses the LA terminal disruption; not a complete operating timeline.

sources.title: APM recovery update
sources.supported_background: Describes staged recovery of LA gate services, not proof of full recovery at every terminal.

sources.title: Port of LA backlog and proposed fee
sources.supported_background: Port announcement described roughly 40% of imports dwelling at least nine days; no historical container list is reproduced here.

sources.title: Port of LA fee program conclusion
sources.supported_background: The proposed additional container dwell fee was never activated. Its accrued amount is zero in this historical-background scenario.

sources.title: Port of LA Hilary update
sources.supported_background: The August 21 update reported normal operations without damage. This is a warning/no-closure control, not a shutdown reconstruction.
